title: USA PATRIOT Act 2001 (Luật Yêu nước Mỹ – Chống Khủng bố)

versions.text:
USA PATRIOT Act 2001 (Uniting and Strengthening America by Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism).
Title II: Enhanced surveillance. §215: Thu thập hồ sơ kinh doanh (telephone metadata – sửa đổi bởi USA Freedom Act 2015). National Security Letters (NSLs). Roving wiretaps.
Title III: Anti-money laundering. Title V: Removing obstacles to investigating terrorism.
